{{Short description|Bundle in which the fiber is a surface}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2025}}
{{One source|date=July 2025}}

In [[mathematics]], a '''surface bundle'''<ref>{{cite web |last1=Salter |first1=Nick |last2=Tshishiku |first2=Bena |title=Surface bundles in topology, algebraic geometry, and group theory |url=https://nsalter.science.nd.edu/expository-notes/sbsurvey.pdf |website=nsalter.science.nd.edu |access-date=21 July 2025 |date=21 October 2019}}</ref> is a [[fiber bundle|bundle]] in which the fiber is a [[Surface (topology)|surface]].  When the base space is a circle the total space is [[3-manifold|three-dimensional]] and is often called a [[surface bundle over the circle]].
